items.title: Hal Espinosa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 20, 2024
items.q: And in the section when I was there it was Bill Chase, myself, Gerry Lamy, Don Rader, and John Bennett and we were the trumpet section.

ctx.x: What is low bread back then?
$135 for the section players. Bill Chase was getting $175.
